name: Amber
source:
24 year old shapeshifting witch studying magic under Colinet.
They never had much attachment to their sex (whatever it initially was) and so they often switch between feminine and masculine form - the more often the more it irks the person they're speaking with.

[From [url=https://animefanka.itch.io/coiled-up-together]itch.io[/url]]
